text: Complete your preparation sheets as follows. The amounts you cook should be sufficient for two
or three people. You may use recipe books.
At the end of the planning session, give your question paper, preparation sheets and any notes
you have made to the Supervisor. You may not take these away from the planning session. You
may not bring any additional notes to the practical test.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a hot pudding with a sauce and make a batch of savoury scones.
2 (a) Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different dairy product
from the following list:
butter, cheese, cream, milk, yogurt.
At least two of the dishes must be savoury.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a dish to show the use of a frying pan and make a dish using oats.
3 Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes to serve at a local music and street food festival. Three
of the dishes must be savoury and one of the dishes must be a batch of small cakes or a tray
bake.

text: At the beginning of the practical test, you will be given back your question paper, preparation
sheets and any notes you made during the planning session.
For the purposes of the Practical Test, a balanced main meal must consist of:
TWO skilful dishes plus a minimum of TWO suitable accompaniments.
1 (a) Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two women who are lactating.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal that is high in calcium and vitamin D.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a savoury dish to show the use of a rolling pin and make a sweet dish using the
whisking method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve three skilful savoury dishes that are suitable for vegans.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a sweet dish using dried fruit and make a cake using the creaming method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve four skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different main
ingredient from the following list:
chicken, green leafy vegetable, nuts, rice, soya, tropical fruit.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful savoury dishes each showing the use of a different root
or tuber vegetable.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using yeast and make a batch of scones.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two elderly relatives.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a dish using shortcrust pastry and make a dish using the melting method.
